understanding: Without kicking things around with colleagues, you lose your bearing on what problems matter.
evidence: If you don't kick things around in the cafeteria or the faculty lounge, you lose your bearing on what problems actually matter
before: a person beside a cafeteria with a mostly full bearing tank
transformation: the person stays away and the bearing drains
after: the bearing tank is nearly empty, its old level dashed

camera.purpose: person, cafeteria and bearing together so the loss is read as caused by staying away

required: the person apart from the cafeteria
